heading.title: Security for Keeping the Peace and for Good Behaviour

article.title: Procedure in respect of person present in Court
article.content: If the person in respect of whom such order is made is present in Court, it shall be read over to him, or, if he so desires, the substance thereof shall be explained to him.
article.html:
131Procedure in respect of person present in Court

Section 131 · Chapter IX

If the person in respect of whom such order is made is present in Court, it shall be read over to him, or, if he so desires, the substance thereof shall be explained to him.
